| KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-10.1.2-001 | T002 applicability decision \(KMIPKIT-DEC-018\): pinned KMIP Specification v2.1 specifies this mandatory TTLV encoding/tag rule but does not identify its endpoint actor or direction. KMIPKit maps it to outbound client request encoding for the 14 client\_1\_0 profiles and conditional HTTPS Client, all of which use TTLV in 1.0. JSON, XML, and PKCS#11 remain out of scope. Existing implementation and verification references are not upgraded to profile-readiness evidence; no requirement-specific official Test Case ID is explicitly linked by the pinned OASIS sources. | KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §10.1.2 |

| KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-4.14-001-001 | Pinned KMIP Specification v2.1 §4.14 and Tables 55–56 define the optional request field and identify the client as its initial setter; Table 55 encodes Qlength as an Integer, and §4.14 says it applies to algorithms such as DSA and DH. The local fake-transport test proves that caller-supplied DSA and Qlength are emitted unchanged in a Create Key Pair request. The typed profile rule checks the Cryptographic Domain Parameters Structure and every present Qlength member's Integer type while preserving omission and unrelated operations. The source's examples are not treated as an exhaustive algorithm allowlist. This evidence does not establish server acceptance, an official OASIS test pass, or formal profile conformance. No requirement-specific official Test Cases ID is linked by the pinned OASIS sources. | KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §4.14 |
| KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-4.14-001-002 | Pinned KMIP Specification v2.1 §4.14 and Tables 55–56 define optional Cryptographic Domain Parameters fields; Qlength is an Integer and applies to algorithms such as DSA and DH. The client supplies the attribute in a Create Key Pair request. This evidence covers the caller-selected DSA Qlength case, with Qlength encoded as an Integer and emitted in the request; the profile evaluator preserves omission and rejects a non-Integer Qlength. These examples are not an exhaustive list. No Recommended Curve, other domain-parameter field, object-type pairing matrix, algorithm/object mismatch rejection, server acceptance, official OASIS test pass, or formal profile conformance is evidenced. No requirement-specific official Test Cases ID is linked by the pinned OASIS sources. | KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §4.14 |
| KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-4.16-001-001 | Specification v2.1 §4.16 defines Cryptographic Parameters as a structure with OPTIONAL fields. The typed profile rule validates any supplied structure without requiring it. The linked profile and serializer tests cover omission of the optional parameter structure/field on the tested Encrypt and Decrypt paths only; they do not establish omission behavior for every operation that uses Cryptographic Parameters. No requirement-specific official Test Cases ID is explicitly linked by the pinned OASIS sources in KMIPKIT-0002; these local tests are not official OASIS evidence or formal profile conformance. | KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §4.16 |
| KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-4.16-001-002 | Pinned KMIP Specification v2.1 §4.16 permits Cryptographic Parameters fields that apply only to certain Managed Object types. | KMIPKIT-REQ-SPEC-6.1.43-005 | KMIP Specification v2.1 §6.1.43 Table 291 permits the client to wrap the registered object and attributes. Sections 3.2–3.3 Tables 13–15 describe the optional associated Attributes Structure and TTLV encoding of a wrapped Key Value; §11.18 Table 450 identifies TTLV Encoding. The fake-transport test forwards a deterministic AES-128-WRAP fixture whose unwrapped plaintext was verified to match a TTLV Key Value Structure containing Key Material and associated Attributes. This demonstrates caller-supplied wire preservation only: KMIPKit does not encrypt, decrypt, parse the wrapped contents, or assert server acceptance. The profile test checks the supported wire types and leaves wrapping optional. No requirement-specific official Test Cases ID is linked by the pinned OASIS sources. | KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §3.2, KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §3.3, KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §6.1.43, KMIPKIT-SRC-spec §11.18 |

## Project policies

| Policy | Provenance | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| KMIPKIT-POLICY-BATCH-ERROR-CONTINUATION-ASSIGNED-OUTBOUND | approved\_product\_decision | Accept only OASIS-assigned Batch Error Continuation values for outbound requests in KMIPKIT-0007; preserve raw Enumeration values when decoding and do not claim the Table 435 extension allocation invalid. |
| KMIPKIT-POLICY-EXTENSION-PRESERVATION | AGENTS.md | Preserve unknown KMIP extension data losslessly and expose it without interpreting it as a standardized value. |
| KMIPKIT-POLICY-UNKNOWN-FUTURE-VALUE-PRESERVATION | AGENTS.md | Preserve unknown or future tags, enumeration values, and bitmask bits without assigning them standardized KMIP semantics. |
| KMIPKIT-POLICY-VENDOR-VALUE-PRESERVATION | AGENTS.md | Preserve vendor-defined values distinctly from OASIS-assigned, reserved, unused, and unknown-to-KMIPKit values. |
